pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal regions with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Patch size is maximal on the upper neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more densely packed irregular quadrilaterals and pentagons on the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored interstitial pathways. Topological nodes are predominantly tri-radial intersections. Pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform on the flank but exhibits widening and increased geometric variance at the ventral and shoulder transitions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible dark mane along the upper neck presenting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized structural depression in the mane line is visible at the junction where the dorsal neck meets the shoulder ridge.
